requirement.statement: TUI questionnaire replies SHALL continue the unblocked runtime turn rather than treating mailbox submission as final completion.

case.given: A runtime bridge supports submitQuestionnaireResponse and resumeTurn
case.when: The user replies to a pending questionnaire
case.then: The TUI SHALL submit the answer and then call resumeTurn on the same runtime session

case.given: The resumed runtime emits assistant output after questionnaire approval
case.when: The answer is submitted through the TUI question bridge
case.then: The TUI SHALL synchronize and expose the assistant output before returning the session to idle

requirement.statement: Foreground runtime execution SHALL return control promptly when a questionnaire reaches a human wait boundary, without classifying the wait as an unsettled timeout.

case.given: A foreground fiber is suspended for human input with pause_all and retains a questionnaire_pending control marker
case.when: The foreground runtime is driven until settled
case.then: The runtime SHALL return at the human wait boundary without repeatedly resuming the marker

case.given: A foreground fiber is suspended for human input with continue_others and its only pending wake item is the questionnaire_pending marker
case.when: No other foreground fiber has runnable work
case.then: The runtime SHALL return at the human wait boundary without repeatedly resuming the marker

case.given: A foreground questionnaire is waiting for a human while unrelated background work remains registered
case.when: The interactive turn reaches the questionnaire wait
case.then: The foreground turn SHALL return without waiting for the unrelated background work

case.given: The interactive coordinator observes a main or pause_all foreground human wait
case.when: The runtime may or may not be at a snapshot safepoint
case.then: The coordinator SHALL report blocked_on_human with the actual safepoint state and SHALL NOT report timeout_unsettled

requirement.statement: TUI conversation history SHALL expose the user's questionnaire answer rather than the internal tool-result envelope.

case.given: A questionnaire tool result contains canonical JSON with questionnaireId and rawText
case.then: The visible text SHALL be rawText while the canonical JSON remains available to runtime/provider history

requirement.statement: Questionnaire continuation SHALL 把 `resumeTurn` 的 `onControl`、`onChunk` 与 runtime history 全部交给通用 turn surface projector，并在 durable resync 时按稳定 identity reconciliation；continuation MUST NOT 把全部 chunk 硬编码为 assist。

case.given: 问卷恢复后的 turn 发出 turn、think、toolcall、result、assist 与 done 类别以及同一 toolCallId 的 history events
case.then: 类别 SHALL 进入各自 surface，且同一 tool call 只 SHALL 有一个 ToolPart
恢复完成后的 conversation resync MUST NOT 复制已显示卡片
